dataIdInfo.idPurp: To capture medium-scale demographic trends influencing long-term flood exposure.
dataIdInfo.idAbs: District-level demographic dataset integrating population time-series indicators for Austria.
dataIdInfo.idCredit: PLUS – ZGIS, Department of Geoinformatics, University of Salzburg

themeKeys.keyword: P_change, Inte_index, social vulnerability, evacuation, Austria, L3

enttyp.enttypd: Each entity represents a spatial feature (polygon)
enttyp.enttypds: Author-defined, based on analytical purpose and processing logic of this study, following ISO 19115 metadata guidance and ArcGIS Pro documentation standards.

attr.attrdef: The Population Change Index calculates the velocity of demographic expansion between 2002 and 2025.
attr.attrdefs: P_change = (TOT_2025 - TOT_2002)/TOT_2002 *100. This metric reflects the evolution of human "value-at-risk" within static hydrological boundaries.

attr.attrdef: The Internationalization Index quantifies the proportion of foreign nationals within the exposed population to measure "Information Vulnerability". It identifies areas where traditional mono-lingual emergency protocols may fail due to language barriers or smaller local support networks.
attr.attrdefs: Calculated using the formula: Inte_index = INT_2025/TOT_2025*100. It serves as a proxy for the recipient's ability to decode emergency broadcasts and navigate municipal evacuation protocols999.
